name: Hyatt Place Phuket Patong
short_description: A 161-room select-service Hyatt Place on a hill above Patong, a 3-minute walk to the beach, and the first Hyatt Place in Southeast Asia.
ai_summary: Hyatt Place Phuket Patong was the first Hyatt Place hotel in Southeast Asia, set on a hill overlooking the Andaman Sea a short walk from Patong Beach. Most rooms face west, giving guests sunset views from their balconies, and the compact, stylish rooms suit budget-conscious travelers wanting a Hyatt-branded stay in the heart of Patong's nightlife and shopping district. As a select-service property it skips the full-service amenities of Phuket's larger resorts, and some guests report mixed experiences with housekeeping consistency.

faqs.question: Is Hyatt Place Phuket Patong close to the beach?
faqs.answer: Yes -- it's about a 3-minute walk to Patong Beach, and the hotel sits on a hill overlooking the Andaman Sea, with most rooms facing west so guests get sunset views from their private balconies without needing to leave the hotel.

faqs.question: Was Hyatt Place Phuket Patong the first Hyatt Place in the region?
faqs.answer: Yes -- it opened as the first Hyatt Place hotel in Southeast Asia, bringing the brand's stylish, casual select-service format (free Wi-Fi, 24-hour food, a Cozy Corner sofa-sleeper in every room) to Phuket's Patong Beach area.
